reviews.comment: 404 is not a difficult class, you could tell this wasn't Schafer's favorite class to teach. If you go to class, pay attention, answer questions, and talk to her after class-- she will like you. She did disclaim at the beginning of the semester she "was raised in a house of all women so if she has an attitude don't take it personally"
L bozo fr she dont care

I cannot agree more with the other comment, this professor is not professional at all. The course itself is fine, but the attitude is not. She did not care about correcting some mistakes she made during the class and definitely put teaching to her lowest priority. I hope she did not get tenure here. This is not derogatory, but a fact.

reviews.comment: Overall, STAT 404 itself isn't awful. The homework can be a pain and honestly can take foreverrrrr. In regards to Schafer, she has quite an attitude. She seemed like she never wanted to be there. Also, forget about asking her questions; I felt degraded anytime I asked her a something, so I just gave up and remained quiet.
